prompt: A client reports that the `Location` header never shows up on 201 responses. Tap the faulty line.
code:
s.mu.Lock()
	t := Todo{ID: len(s.todos) + 1, Title: in.Title}
	s.todos = append(s.todos, t)
	s.mu.Unlock()
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, t)
	w.Header().Set("Location", "/todos/"+strconv.Itoa(t.ID))
explain: Headers must be set before `WriteHeader` or the first `Write`. `writeJSON` already sent the status line and body, so a header set afterwards is silently ignored.
